name: Equifax: credit freeze
tip: A free freeze stops anyone opening new credit in your name using your Equifax report. It asks for your Social Security number, so type it only on their own site. Make an account, place the freeze and save the PIN or password they give you. Already frozen? Tap MARK AS DONE.

name: Experian: credit freeze
tip: A free freeze stops anyone opening new credit in your name using your Experian report. It asks for your Social Security number, so type it only on their own site. Make an account, place the freeze and save the PIN they give you. Already frozen? Tap MARK AS DONE.

name: TransUnion: credit freeze
tip: A free freeze stops anyone opening new credit in your name using your TransUnion report. It asks for your Social Security number, so type it only on their own site. Make an account, place the freeze and save the PIN they give you. Already frozen? Tap MARK AS DONE.

name: Innovis: credit freeze (the fourth bureau)
tip: Innovis is a smaller credit bureau that most people forget. Use the online form on the page, or call 1-866-712-4546. It asks for your Social Security number, so type it only on their own site. They mail you a letter with a 10-digit PIN. Keep it, you need it to lift the freeze. Then tap MARK AS DONE.

name: ChexSystems: bank report freeze
tip: Banks check this report before they open an account for you. The freeze is free. Make a portal account, then pick Security Freeze. It asks for your Social Security number, birth date and driver license number, so type them only on their own site. The freeze starts within 24 hours. Save the PIN: you will need it before you open a new bank account. Then tap MARK AS DONE.

name: NCTUE: phone and utility report freeze
tip: Phone, cable and utility companies check this before they give you service. The freeze is free. Enter your name, Social Security number, birth date and address, tap place a freeze each time it asks, then download the confirmation page. It holds the PIN you need to lift the freeze. You can also call 866-349-5355. Then tap MARK AS DONE.

name: LexisNexis Risk: report freeze
tip: Insurers, lenders and others buy LexisNexis reports on you. A freeze is free and stops them getting yours. On the page choose the online request for yourself and fill it in. They mail a letter to confirm. You can also call 1-800-456-1244. Then tap MARK AS DONE.

name: Clarity Services: loan report freeze (Experian)
tip: Payday and small-loan lenders check Clarity. Use the online page to place a freeze, or call 866-390-3118 on weekdays, 9 to 5 Eastern. Save the PIN. Then tap MARK AS DONE.

name: The Work Number: pay and job history freeze
tip: Equifax keeps your pay and job history, and lenders, landlords and employers can look it up. A freeze is free and blocks those lookups. Tap Start a Data Freeze, make an account and fill in the form. Or call 1-800-367-2884. Later, if a lender needs your pay, the site lets you give them a one-time key. Check the site afterwards that the freeze shows active. Then tap MARK AS DONE.

name: Verisk: insurance claims report
tip: Insurers look at Verisk's claims history to price your car and home insurance. You can get one copy free each year. On the page pick the Property, Coverage or Auto form (the Auto one is only for GM, Hyundai and Honda drivers), fill it in and email it to FCRA-NPC@verisk.com. Or call 1-800-627-3487 and ask for the free report. They mail it to you. Then tap MARK AS DONE. Not interested? Tap NOT LISTED.

name: MIB: insurance medical record
tip: Life, health and disability insurers share a coded record here, but only if you applied for individual life or health insurance in the last seven years. You can see yours free once a year. Use the online form on the page or call them. They mail it, or tell you right away if there is no record. If you never applied for that kind of insurance, tap NOT LISTED.

name: The Retail Equation: store return tracking
tip: Many big stores scan your ID when you return something and send it here to decide whether to refuse future returns. You can ask for your free report from their site, by calling 800-652-2331, or by mail to The Retail Equation, P.O. Box 51373, Irvine, CA 92619-1373. If a store never scanned your ID, tap NOT LISTED.

name: Comscore (audience tracking)
tip: Comscore tracks what people browse to sell audience numbers. Easiest: tap SEND EMAIL REQUEST. Or use their form: choose delete and opt out of sale and targeted advertising. Their data is tied to your browser and phone, not your name, so they may ask for more details to match you. If they say they cannot find you, tap NOT LISTED.
